DeepSeek provides no population, raw temperature encoding, sentinel, scale, range or precision evidence and cannot show Type 27 cooling-device references.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. DMTF maps the probe fields to Type 28 and the listed chassis fields to Type 3; Type 27 records may reference Type 28 and are reconciled against the approved cooling topology. Both source branches remain. Raw encodings, sentinels, units, population and engineering relationships are checked against Project matrices. This validates firmware metadata only, not live sensor calibration or thermal response.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1940, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1947 / Wistron-BIOS-00488-V002 / 100489665ff139fb.
DMTF maps Type 28 versus Type 3 fields exactly, resolving field ownership without dropping Procedure coverage.
Raw encoded temperature values and unknown sentinels are preserved alongside normalized units; unknown is not interpreted as zero or a passing value.
Probe description/location/status, min/nominal/max and precision metadata are checked coherently, and expected Type 27 references must resolve to the correct Type 28 handle.
This case reads declared metadata only; no heat stimulus, calibrated sensor comparison, threshold change or active fan operation is within scope.
No dmidecode, SSH, reboot, log-clear, thermal/fan control, firmware, SMBIOS or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: SMBIOS Type 28 temperature-probe metadata, Type 27 references and Type 3 persistence
test_case.purpose: Verify complete Type 28 probe population, raw/normalized temperature metadata, expected Type 27 references and listed Type 3 chassis fields against exact matrices before and after one approved reboot without live thermal claims.
required_package: Exact target/BIOS/SMBIOS identity and Type 28 matrix with count, descriptions, locations/statuses, raw encoding/scale/sentinel policy, min/max/nominal/resolution/tolerance/accuracy and OEM values
Expected Type 27-to-Type 28 reference topology and Type 3 chassis matrix
Validated dmidecode and complete Type 28/27/3 parser preserving handles, raw encodings, stderr/status and protected evidence
Secure access, approved OS warm reboot/window/Boot ID timeout and independent recovery
Preserved platform logs and statement that calibrated thermal validation is separate
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY COLLECTION AROUND ONE APPROVED REBOOT; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind target identity and preserve logs. Securely save complete `dmidecode --type 28`, relevant `--type 27`, and `--type 3` output/status. For each Type 28 handle retain raw encoding, decode sentinel/units, validate identity/location/status and approved range/precision metadata; reconcile expected Type 27 references and separately validate Type 3. After one approved OS warm reboot with same-target Boot ID/OS Ready proof, repeat and semantic-diff. Do not clear logs, alter thermal/fan/firmware/SMBIOS state, expose secrets, retry or claim calibrated/live response.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected Type 28 probe is present once with correct description, location/status, raw/sentinel/normalized range and precision metadata; every expected Type 27 reference resolves correctly and Type 3 fields match the recipe. All remain stable after OS Ready with no thermal/platform-health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete successful pre/post Type 28/27/3 evidence, exact population/value/sentinel/reference/chassis checks, approved Boot ID-changing reboot and OS Ready. FAIL on missing/duplicate probe, wrong location/status/value/scale/sentinel, incoherent approved metadata, bad Type 27 reference, companion mismatch or reboot/health failure. NOT READY covers missing matrices/access/recovery. Header grep or live-thermal claims cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only metadata only; never apply heat, change thresholds/fan policy, BIOS, SMBIOS or firmware.
Preserve raw encodings/logs and protect identity/OEM data; never clear logs or suppress errors.
Use secure verified access and approved reboot/recovery; no plaintext secret or disabled host verification.
Stop on wrong target, parser ambiguity, thermal anomaly or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, target/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode/parser identity and Type 28, Type 27-reference and Type 3 matrices
Complete pre/post Type 28/27/3 raw output/status and hashes
Per-probe handle, identity/location/status, raw/sentinel/normalized values and Type 27 reference evaluation
Approved reboot timeline, Boot IDs, same-target OS Ready and preserved logs/thermal health
No-live-thermal-claim/no-clear/no-write/no-retry audit, workload restore and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On reboot failure preserve first evidence and use only approved console/BMC recovery. On missing/invalid probe or broken Type 27 reference, preserve complete SMBIOS/firmware identity, make no thermal/fan/BIOS change and escalate. Do not auto-reboot or stimulate heat to force metadata alignment.
